_doc: Hand corrections for scripts/generate-dam-roster.py. Every coordinate here is traceable to USGS site locations (anchorSites are resolved from the USGS site service at generation time; explicit lat/lon carry a note naming the sites).

dams: keyed by the generated dam name. impoundmentLakeID (a DirectoryLake.id) or impoundmentName fixes a reservoir the name match cannot find; normalPoolFt is used only when no USGS pool median or NWPS full pool exists (spec order); anchorSites / lat+lon re-anchor; river and rename are cosmetic.
lakes: keyed by DirectoryLake.id, for hasDam lakes. damName names the generated dam; anchorSites or lat+lon anchor it when the USGS pool/tailrace pair rule cannot.
add: dams no rule generates (no directory lake, gauge not named BELOW..DAM).
drop: generated dam names to leave out.

Jordan Dam._why: AlabamaPowerGenerationService's coordinate is a point on the impoundment, 3.8 mi above 'COOSA RIVER AT JORDAN DAM'; a reach starting there runs down the lake.

Bankhead Dam._why: APC impoundment point is 8.1 mi above the USGS gauges at / below Bankhead L&D.

Holt Dam._why: APC impoundment point is 6.4 mi above the USGS gauges at / below Holt L&D.

Eufaula / W.F. George|AL._why: The pool gauge is 'WALTER F. GEORGE RESERVOIR', the tailrace 'BELOW WFG DAM': neither name-matches 'W.F. George'.

Philpott Lake|VA._why: Pool gauge 'PHILPOTT RES AT PHILPOTT DAM' and 'SMITH RIVER NEAR PHILPOTT' 0.3 mi below; the river gauge is not named as a tailrace.

Lake of the Ozarks|MO._why: 'Lake of the Ozarks near Bagnell' sits at the dam (0.05 mi from the public dam coordinate); no tailrace gauge exists.

Lake Moomaw|VA._why: 'JACKSON RIVER BL GATHRIGHT DAM' names the dam, not the lake.

Lake Livingston|TX.note: midpoint of USGS 08066190 'Livingston Res nr Goodrich' (30.63353,-95.01021) and discontinued 08066192 'Trinity Rv bl Livingston Dam' (30.63159,-95.01994); 08066192 has no IV/DV record so the pair rule cannot see it

add.name: Murray Lock and Dam
add._why: Low-head lock and dam with no directory lake; its gauge 'Arkansas River at Murray Dam' carries HEADWATER/TAILWATER method blocks, not a BELOW..DAM name.
